scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n turbo,storybook -c blue,magenta "turbo watch build" "pnpm --filter docs storybook"
scripts.ios:workbench: pnpm build && xcodegen generate --spec apps/ios-workbench/project.yml && open apps/ios-workbench/iOSComponentWorkbench.xcodeproj
scripts.ios:build: pnpm build && xcodegen generate --spec apps/ios-workbench/project.yml && xcodebuild -project apps/ios-workbench/iOSComponentWorkbench.xcodeproj -scheme iOSComponentWorkbench -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' build
scripts.test: turbo run test && vitest run --project scripts
